phases.name: Rust Backend: WalletService and Read DTOs

steps.name: WalletService struct, SyncState, and typed DTOs
steps.description: Create application/wallet_service.rs with WalletService struct holding a tokio::sync::Mutex<Wallet>, Arc<RwLock<SyncState>>, sync_in_flight AtomicBool, and last_read_at. Define BalanceDto, UtxoDto, OutPointDto, KeychainDto, AddressDto, SyncStatusDto, TypedError, and extend AdminWalletError with RpcUnreachable, RpcAuthFailed, DescriptorParseError, SyncIncomplete, RegtestGuardViolation, Disabled variants. Extend infrastructure/admin_wallet/wallet.rs with pure read helpers used by WalletService methods.
criteria: WalletService struct defined in desktop-app/src-tauri/src/application/wallet_service.rs with wallet, sync_state, sync_in_flight, and last_read_at fields
BalanceDto has confirmed_sats: u64, unconfirmed_sats: u64, total_sats: u64; all fields derive serde::Serialize/Deserialize
UtxoDto has outpoint: OutPointDto, value_sats: u64, script_pubkey_hex: String, keychain: KeychainDto, derivation_index: u32, confirmations: u32
AddressDto has index: u32, address: String, is_used: bool
SyncStatusDto has tip_height: Option<u32>, last_synced_block: Option<u32>, last_synced_at: Option<String> (ISO-8601), is_syncing: bool, last_error: Option<TypedError>
AdminWalletError enum extended with RpcUnreachable, RpcAuthFailed, DescriptorParseError, SyncIncomplete, RegtestGuardViolation, Disabled variants
AdminWalletError::Disabled is returned when COMMIT_FUNDING != admin_wallet OR BITCOIN_NETWORK != regtest OR ALLOW_DEV_MNEMONIC_SIGNING != 1 (US-RP2.AC-3)
cargo fmt --check passes; cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings passes
steps.scenario_name: WalletService struct and DTO definitions compile and satisfy type constraints

steps.name: WalletService get_balance, list_utxos, list_addresses methods
steps.description: Implement get_balance, list_utxos, and list_addresses on WalletService. Each method acquires the wallet mutex, copies required data into a DTO, and releases the lock without awaiting network I/O. list_addresses enforces page_size cap of 20, returns empty Vec for out-of-bound pages, and uses BDK heuristic is_used. confirmations for UTXOs derived from BDK chain state: tip_height.saturating_sub(utxo_height).saturating_add(1) when confirmed, else 0. Add unit tests embedded in source for DTO shaping and address windowing invariants.
criteria: get_balance returns BalanceDto reflecting last successful sync; on never-synced wallet all fields are 0 (US-RP2.AC-2)
list_utxos returns Vec<UtxoDto> with confirmations computed from BDK chain state, NOT gettxout RPC (US-RP3.AC-2)
list_utxos returns empty Vec for empty wallet, not an error (US-RP3.AC-3)
list_addresses with page_index=0 returns indices 0..=19 of the requested keychain (US-RP4.AC-3)
list_addresses with out-of-bound page returns [], not an error (US-RP4.AC-4)
page_size is defaulted to and capped at 20 (US-RP4.AC-1)
Unit test: UtxoDto confirmation arithmetic on tip / spent / unconfirmed cases
Unit test: address windowing returns correct index ranges for external page 0 and internal page 1
Unit test: AdminWalletError::Disabled returned when each guard condition fails (US-RP2.AC-3)
cargo fmt --check passes; cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings passes
steps.scenario_name: get_balance, list_utxos, list_addresses methods with unit tests for DTO shaping and address windowing

steps.name: WalletService sync, sync_status methods and background sync loop
steps.description: Implement sync() and sync_status() on WalletService. sync() checks sync_in_flight AtomicBool to collapse concurrent callers; performs bdk_bitcoind_rpc Emitter cycle while holding wallet mutex; updates SyncState on success or records typed error. sync_status() reads Arc<RwLock<SyncState>> without acquiring the wallet mutex. Spawn background sync tokio task on first IPC invocation: loop sleeping SYNC_INTERVAL (30s const), checking last_read_at against SYNC_IDLE_WINDOW (5min const), calling sync() when active. Add unit test for concurrent sync() collapse.
criteria: sync() resolves after success or returns typed error mapping to RpcUnreachable, RpcAuthFailed, DescriptorParseError, SyncIncomplete, RegtestGuardViolation (US-RP5.AC-2)
sync_status() returns SyncStatusDto snapshot without blocking on wallet mutex (US-RP5.AC-1)
Two concurrent calls to sync() collapse into one in-flight sync; no double-RPC storm (US-RP5.AC-4)
Background loop runs at SYNC_INTERVAL = 30s cadence while last IPC read was within SYNC_IDLE_WINDOW = 5min (US-RP5.AC-3)
Background loop suspends when no read IPC invoked in past 5 minutes (US-RP5.AC-3)
SYNC_INTERVAL and SYNC_IDLE_WINDOW are Rust constants, not env vars (US-RP5.AC-3, D6)
While is_syncing == true, read IPC commands return last successful snapshot, not an error (US-RP5.AC-5)
Unit test: concurrent sync() calls assert single Emitter cycle observed
cargo fmt --check passes; cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings passes
steps.scenario_name: sync and sync_status methods with background loop and concurrent collapse

steps.name: 5 new IPC commands, WalletService managed state, and Tauri registration
steps.description: Add admin_wallet_get_balance, admin_wallet_list_utxos, admin_wallet_list_addresses, admin_wallet_sync, admin_wallet_sync_status commands to commands/admin_wallet.rs. Each command resolves WalletService via tauri::State<Arc<WalletService>>. Construct one WalletService in Tauri setup and place it in managed state. Register all 5 commands in commands/invoke.rs alongside existing get_admin_wallet_info.
criteria: admin_wallet_get_balance command exists and returns BalanceDto or AdminWalletError (US-RP2.AC-1)
admin_wallet_list_utxos command returns Vec<UtxoDto> or AdminWalletError (US-RP3.AC-1)
admin_wallet_list_addresses command accepts keychain, page_index, page_size params and returns Vec<AddressDto> or AdminWalletError (US-RP4.AC-1)
admin_wallet_sync command performs chain sync and returns SyncStatusDto or typed AdminWalletError (US-RP5.AC-2)
admin_wallet_sync_status command returns SyncStatusDto snapshot (US-RP5.AC-1)
All 5 commands return AdminWalletError::Disabled when guard conditions not met (US-RP2.AC-3, US-RP3.AC-4, US-RP4.AC-5)
WalletService constructed once in Tauri setup and placed in managed state; commands resolve it via tauri::State<Arc<WalletService>>
All 5 commands registered in commands/invoke.rs
cargo build succeeds; cargo fmt --check passes; cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings passes
steps.scenario_name: 5 IPC commands registered with WalletService managed state

phases.name: React Layer: Hooks and BroadcastDetailsCard Extension

steps.name: TypeScript IPC adapter extensions and 4 React hooks
steps.description: Extend api/admin-wallet.ts with one typed function per new IPC command: getAdminWalletBalance, listAdminWalletUtxos, listAdminWalletAddresses, triggerAdminWalletSync, getAdminWalletSyncStatus. Define TS types BalanceDto, UtxoDto, OutPointDto, AddressDto, SyncStatusDto, AdminWalletError union. Create 4 hooks under domain/admin-wallet/hooks/: use-admin-wallet-balance.ts, use-admin-wallet-utxos.ts, use-admin-wallet-addresses.ts, use-admin-wallet-sync.ts. Each hook returns { data, isLoading, error, refresh }. useAdminWalletSync additionally exposes syncStatus and triggerSync(). Hooks call getAdminWalletSyncStatus for cache invalidation on sync completion.
criteria: api/admin-wallet.ts extended with getAdminWalletBalance, listAdminWalletUtxos, listAdminWalletAddresses, triggerAdminWalletSync, getAdminWalletSyncStatus typed functions (US-RP6.AC-2)
TS types BalanceDto, UtxoDto, AddressDto, SyncStatusDto, AdminWalletError defined with no any/unknown leaks
useAdminWalletBalance, useAdminWalletUtxos, useAdminWalletAddresses, useAdminWalletSync hooks created under desktop-app/src/domain/admin-wallet/hooks/ (US-RP6.AC-2)
Each hook returns { data, isLoading, error, refresh } with data typed against IPC schema and error typed as AdminWalletError (US-RP6.AC-1)
useAdminWalletSync exposes syncStatus and triggerSync() and is the only hook that calls admin_wallet_sync (US-RP6.AC-3)
Other hooks do not trigger sync; they subscribe to status changes for cache invalidation (US-RP6.AC-3)
useAdminWalletAddresses defaults page_size to 20 and caps at 20
npm run build passes; npm run lint passes; npm run format:check passes
steps.scenario_name: TypeScript IPC adapter and 4 React hooks with typed contracts

steps.name: BroadcastDetailsCard extension and broadcast-proposal-screen wiring
steps.description: Extend BroadcastDetailsCard with optional props utxoCount?: number, lastSyncedAt?: string | null, syncError?: AdminWalletErrorDto | null. Render 'UTXOs: <N>' when utxoCount is non-undefined. Render 'Last sync: <relative time>' computed from lastSyncedAt, refreshed at least every 15s while screen is mounted. When syncError is non-null, replace relative-time field with 'Sync error: <typed message>' and hide stale timestamp. When all new props are undefined, card renders byte-identical to Phase 1 (regression gate). Extend broadcast-proposal-screen.tsx to consume useAdminWalletUtxos and useAdminWalletSync when useAdminWalletInfo returns non-null, and pass new props through.
criteria: BroadcastDetailsCard renders 'UTXOs: <N>' where <N> matches count from admin_wallet_list_utxos when COMMIT_FUNDING=admin_wallet (US-RP1.AC-1)
'Last sync: <relative time>' updates at least every 15s while screen is mounted (US-RP1.AC-2)
When COMMIT_FUNDING is unset or bitcoind, card renders unchanged from Phase 1 — new props are undefined (US-RP1.AC-3)
When most recent sync failed, card shows 'Sync error: <typed message>' and does NOT show stale 'Last sync' value (US-RP1.AC-4)
broadcast-proposal-screen.tsx consumes useAdminWalletUtxos and useAdminWalletSync only when funding mode is admin_wallet
npm run build passes; npm run lint passes; npm run format:check passes
steps.scenario_name: BroadcastDetailsCard renders UTXO count and sync status with Phase 1 regression guard
